name: juno-pad
description:
Preset: juno-pad
Description: Warm Juno-inspired saw/PWM pad, gentle drift, slow filter breathing, chorus and vintage reverb; original Afterimage Garden harmony patch.
Author: serum-mcp

Osc A: ON   octave=+0  volume=0.48  pan=+0  wavetable=analog_warm  table_pos=45.0  warp=fm(0.00)  unison=3  detune=0.04
Osc B: ON   octave=+0  volume=0.26  pan=+0  wavetable=pwm  table_pos=70.0  warp=fm(0.00)  unison=2  detune=0.04
Osc C: off  octave=+0  volume=0.75  pan=+0  wavetable=default  table_pos=0.0  warp=fm(0.00)
Osc Noise: off  octave=+0  volume=0.75  pan=+0  noise_type=White
Osc Sub: off  octave=+0  volume=0.75  pan=+0  sub_shape=saw

Filter 1: ON   type=lowpass_12  cutoff=0.38  resonance=8%  drive=5%  stereo=50%
Filter 2: off  type=lowpass_24  cutoff=0.50  resonance=10%  drive=0%  stereo=50%

Env 1: attack=600.0ms  decay=1.80s  sustain=0.80  release=1.90s

Macro 1 "BRIGHT": 0%
Macro 2 "CHORUS": 0%
Macro 3 "SPACE": 0%
Macro 4 "PWM COLOR": 0%

FX chain:
  - FXChorus (wet=27%)
  - FXReverb (wet=20%)

Mod matrix (recognized routes only):
  - env1 -> filter0.cutoff: +13%
  - lfo0 -> filter0.cutoff: +3%, bipolar
  - lfo0 -> oscillator1.table_position: +5%, bipolar
  - lfo1 -> oscillator0.fine: +0%, bipolar
  - velocity -> filter0.cutoff: +6%

  - macro1 -> fx0.wet: +25%
  - macro2 -> fx1.wet: +20%
  - macro3 -> oscillator1.table_position: +15%

Global: master_volume=0.25  mono=off  poly=16
